findings.finding: TrackWhale reports a distinct 35,000,000 XRP transfer from provider-labelled Ripple account rJqi to unlabeled raRVLN at 20:07 UTC, hash 6EB9F228D2D58631A047D2D8AD003538CD81D7E056028DDD48B809B23B7AD9C7.

The 120M transfer at08:30 and 28M transfer at06:42 are separate from the 35M transfer at20:07. The visible same-day rJqi→raRVLN total is at least183M XRP, not 120M; the earlier 310M headline refers to 190M inbound plus120M outbound, not310M outbound.

Bithomp's account-history page captured at20:09 showed a latest listed rJqi transaction at16:58 and did not display the 20:07 35M transfer. TrackWhale has a transaction-detail page and hash. Treat this as explorer indexing/timestamp disagreement until a second explorer confirms the hash.

The additional 35M transfer arrives at raRVLN after its six 186M XRP transfers to r39TAw earlier in the day. It could be a replenishment or separate treasury/settlement flow; no purpose or ownership is established.
